verification: Every plan is checked by a full component traversal, inside the time budget, before it replaces the current plan. A replacement is smaller than the plan its search started from and never larger than the current plan.
higher_order: Class I after RG saturation and a completed pair scan; Class II in components of size <=35; a neutral (1,1) swap is kept only when the repair that follows it yields a smaller plan.
